::: {#def-brnffrcistg .theorem}
## BRNFFRCISTG model

A bipartite random network finest fully randomized causally interpretable structured tree graph (BRNFFRCISTG) model is a causal model defined on a [bipartite random graph NPSEM-IE](#def-bipartite-random-graph-npsem ) which satisfies the (1) [no spillover](#def-no-spillover), (2) [homogenous random network interference](#def-homogenous-random-network-interference), and (3) [identical distributions](#def-identical-distributions) assumptions.

:::
